key_insight: VerifiedLab turns research records into machine-usable evidence, using role-based AI agents and field-level verification to support claims about perovskite solar cells.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help AI co-scientists reuse solar-cell literature while conditioning recommendations on the reliability of supporting data.
method: A principal investigator agent plans, a librarian computes evidence from records, and specialists draft outputs.
Gate and critic agents check claims against measured data reliability.
The harness decides whether to release or withhold outputs.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive perovskite solar-cell experiments that recover known physical trends and anticipate devices reported a year later, but provides no quantitative metrics.
watch_item: Practical adoption requires reliable field-level verification and evaluation of how added inference-time checking affects cost and predictive performance.
